crossRefs.note: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
These words, which I command you today, shall be on your heart;
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and…
I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men…
As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But…
The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the…
for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should…
Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
“In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he…
For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
What the wicked fear, will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
Then your light will break out as the morning, and your healing will appear quickly; then your righteousness shall go…
but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.
But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his…
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

translations.web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
translations.bsb: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
translations.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
translations.asv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatsoever ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
